8.
Section  17  of  the  principal  enactment  is  hereby
amended as follows:-

(i)
by the insertion immediately after paragraph (c) of
that section of the following paragraph:-

“(d)
fails  to  provide  reasonable  facilities  to  an
authorized officer or his assistants to board
the vessel or adequate security to such officer
and  the  assistants  at  the  time  of  entry  into
such  boat  or  when  they  are  on  board  such
boat,”;

(ii)
by the substitution for the words “after trial without
a jury before a Judge of the High Court” and “to a
fine not exceeding twenty five thousand rupees” of
the words “after trial by a Magistrate”and “to a fine
not less than the amounts specified in column II of
the Schedule V hereto based on the length of the
fishing  boat  specified  in  corresponding  entry  in
the column I of the Schedule V hereto.”.
